notes.title: Thousand Lives is an upcoming minimalist rogue-lite role playing life simulation
notes.notes:
Thousand Lives is a fresh take on a text-adventure styled RPG rogue-lite adventure, and from the little we've seen it's easily worth keeping an eye on.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/06/thousand-lives-is-an-upcoming-minimalist-rogue-lite-role-playing-life-simulation
